## AI Daemons (emerging category)
Riley Tomasek and the Charlie Labs team frame "daemons" as a distinct AI category alongside agents — long-running, self-initiating, role-based background processes that fill the maintenance gap agents leave behind. Tasks vs roles is the core distinction. DAEMON.md as in-repo policy contract (versioned, idempotent, bounded by autonomy/approval matrix).
- [[2026-05-05-charlie-daemons-vs-agents]] — Charlie Labs landing page; agents-vs-daemons framing; "operational debt" as the new technical debt
- [[2026-05-06-how-charlie-daemons-work]] — execution model: 7-stage loop, autonomy/approval matrix, DAEMON.md schema (watch/routines/deny/schedule/body)
- [[2026-05-15-ai-daemons-engineering-maintenance]] — Riley Tomasek manifesto: persistent / self-initiating / role-based; flywheel of zero-marginal-attention, learned norms, earned trust
